cases.title: Create a record through UI and verify persistence

steps.action: Open the record page in a fresh workspace.
steps.expected: Record form and empty list are visible.

steps.action: Enter Cross-layer record and select Create record.
steps.expected: Success is announced and exactly one open record is listed and persisted.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.expected: The created record remains visible.

cases.title: Reject empty UI input without side effects

steps.action: Open a fresh workspace; submit an empty name.
steps.expected: An actionable validation error is announced and no record is persisted.

cases.title: Complete a record from the UI

steps.action: Create an open record in the isolated workspace.
steps.expected: Open record appears in the list.

steps.action: Select Complete for that record.
steps.expected: UI and persisted state both show completed.

steps.action: Open the local page and run axe WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA rule tags.
steps.expected: No violations in the configured automated rules; manual assessment remains separate.

steps.action: Focus Record name; type Keyboard record; press Tab.
steps.expected: Create record receives visible keyboard focus.

steps.action: Press Enter.
steps.expected: Creation is announced and exactly one record is persisted.

steps.action: Request the local page and inspect response headers.
steps.expected: Cache-Control is no-store and X-Content-Type-Options is nosniff.
